decisions.reason: The reference-class electrometer sits at the core of the firm's decades of dosimetry and calibration expertise, so the firm can easily interpret early results and refine it, and as a flagship product on the home page it is very unlikely to be withdrawn.

Oncology risk management software extends the firm's QA software and integration capabilities toward its strategic convergence of machine and patient QA, and its clinical physicists and research cooperation give it the knowledge to assimilate feedback, so it is worth keeping despite somewhat greater distance from the core instruments.
